title: S3 Files coverage
intro: A separate API, not a bucket subresource: file systems, mount targets, access
points, policies and the synchronization configuration. The console reads one
thing from it — `ListFileSystems`, on the Files page and the bucket's *File
systems* tab — and offers no action of its own yet.

gui.ListFileSystems: Files page › table, bucket page › File systems

covered.CreateFileSystem: tests/s3/test_s3files_operations.py (create file system is read back by get and list)
covered.GetFileSystem: tests/s3/test_s3files_operations.py (create file system is read back by get and list)
covered.DeleteFileSystem: tests/s3/test_s3files_operations.py (delete file system removes the file system it created)
covered.GetFileSystemPolicy: tests/s3/test_s3files_operations.py (file system policy is put read and deleted)
covered.PutFileSystemPolicy: tests/s3/test_s3files_operations.py (file system policy is put read and deleted)
covered.DeleteFileSystemPolicy: tests/s3/test_s3files_operations.py (file system policy is put read and deleted)
covered.GetSynchronizationConfiguration: tests/s3/test_s3files_operations.py (synchronization configuration is put and read)
covered.PutSynchronizationConfiguration: tests/s3/test_s3files_operations.py (synchronization configuration is put and read)
covered.TagResource: tests/s3/test_s3files_operations.py (tags are tagged listed and untagged)
covered.UntagResource: tests/s3/test_s3files_operations.py (tags are tagged listed and untagged)
covered.ListTagsForResource: tests/s3/test_s3files_operations.py (tags are tagged listed and untagged)
